Premises: 500 West 22nd St.,NY, NY Premisees: 504 West 22nd St.,NY,NY Block: 693 Block: 693 Lot: 37 Lot:39 AMENDMENTTOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS AMENDMENTTO ZONING LOTDEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Amendment") made February 22, 2019, by SREP 10TH AVENUE VENTURE LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address c/o Soundview Real Estate Partners, 201 Tresser Blvd., Stamford, CT 06901 ("SREP"). RECITALS WHEREAS: A. SREP, in its capacity as the owner of each of: (x) certain land located in the City and State ofNew York, Borough of Manhattan,designated as Lot 37 in Block 693 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Exhibit A annexed hereto and part hereof (Lot 37"); and (y) certain land located in the City and State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, designated as Lot 39 in Block 693 on the Tax Map and more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Exhibit B annexed hereto and part hereof ("Lot 39"), executed a certain Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement (the “Existing ZLDA") dated as of September 13, 2017, and recorded in the City Register of the City of New York ("City_Register") as CRFN: 2017000356076, pursuant to which, inter alia, SREP (in its capacity as the owner of Lot 39, as transferor) conveyed to SREP (in its capacity as the owner of Lot 37, as transferee) the Lot 39 Excess Development Rights (as defined in the Existing ZLDA). SREP seeks to amend, supplement and/or clarify the Existing ZLDA, on the terms and conditions set forth in this Amendment, to restate and replace the Lot 39 Excess Development Rights as defined in the Existing ZLDA. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. Amendment to the Existing ZLDA. Section 1.15 of the Existing ZLDA is hereby deleted and replaced with the following: Lot39ExcessDevelopmentRights”shallmeananyandallDevelopmentRights, regardless of derivation,which are,or have become,appurtenant to the Lot 39 Land and are in excess of the Lot 39 Utilized Development Rights (including withoutlimitation,anysuchDevelopmentRightsthat,pursuanttothatcertain ZoningLotDevelopmentandEasementAgreementdatedMarch7,2014and recorded March 25,2014 in theCity Register of theCity of NewYork as CRFN:

2014000102708 (the “2014 ZLDA"), were received by SREP as Transferee (as definedinthe2014ZLDA). Ratification. The Existing ZLDA, as modified by this Amendment, is ratified and confirmed to be and remain in full force and effect.  3. Binding Effect. The restrictions, covenants, obligations, easements and agreements  contained in this Amendment shall be considered covenants running with the land and shall be binding upon the SREP and its respective successors and assigns with respect to each of Lot 37 and Lot 39, as the case may be. 4. Recording. This Amendment shall be recorded in the City Register, and shall be indexed against each of Lot 37 and Lot 39.  5. Severability. In the event that any provisions of this Amendment shall be deemed, any administrative agency with due authority, such provision shall be severed and the remainder of this Amendment shall continue to be in full force and effect. 6. Final Agreement. The Existing ZLDA, as modified by this Amendment, expresses the final and complete agreement of the parties with respect to the subject matter therein, to the exclusion of any and all oral statements, representations, promises, or agreements and to the exclusion of any and all recorded statements, representations, promises, or agreements except for those executed contemporaneously with the execution of this record.  7.  Counterparts. This Amendment may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which when so executed and delivered shall be deemed an original, but all of which taken together shall be construed as and shall constitute but one and the same instrument. 8. Captions; Headings. The captions, paragraph headings, titles and sections of this Amendment are inserted for convenience only and shall not in any way affect the meaning and construction of any provision of this Amendment. 9. Exhibits. Each of the exhibits referred to herein and attached hereto is incorporated herein by this reference. [THE REMAINDER OF THIS PAGE IS INTENTIONALLY LEFT BLANK]
